game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow, a scarab burrow: the caravan guide must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Print Tracer: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what desert bandits changed.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow: a scarab burrow
core_gameplay_loop: In Scarab Burrow, repeat each round: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what desert bandits changed. Each round, desert bandits strike the palm grove, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trace_clarity value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the palm grove from desert bandits in Scarab Burrow: keep the trace_clarity meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: trace_clarity drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Print Tracer
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Tracer' (Week 9 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Scarab Burrow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_clarity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against desert bandits in Scarab Burrow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while trace_clarity > 0.
